subject: general
question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

(64, 51, 38)
solution:
**Logic : (Second number - First number) = (Second number - Third number)**

Given : (64, 51, 38)

64 - 51 = 51 - 38

**13 = 13 (LHS = RHS)**

So,

 
• (52, 46, 40)

​(52 - 46) = (46 - 40)

6 = 6 (LHS = RHS)

 
• (90, 120, 64)
